items.description: Items is the list of Requests.

listResponseMeta.description: ListResponseMeta is common information about the list.

RequestList.title: Request List
RequestList.description: RequestList is the list of Requests returned by the ListRequest method.

condition.description: Condition is the Rule's condition that must match in order for the Rule, and subsequently the Policy as a whole, to match.

effect.title: Effect
effect.description: Effect is the effect of the Rule on the matched access Request

priority.description: Priority is an integer that sets the Rule priority level. The lower the number, the higher the priority.

action.description: Action is what the Cluster does with the matched Request. It is required for the REVIEW effect and it must not be set for the other ones.

authorization.description: Authorization is the access that is granted to the subject once the Request is approved. It must not be set for the DENY effect.

name.description: Name is the name of the Rule. It is required and it must be unique within the Policy.

octelium.api.main.access.v1.Policy.Spec..title: Rule
octelium.api.main.access.v1.Policy.Spec..description: Rule decides the fate of the access Requests that match its Condition

review.description: Review is the review workflow of the Request.

octelium.api.main.access.v1.Policy.Spec..title: Action
octelium.api.main.access.v1.Policy.Spec..description: Action is what the Cluster does with a Request matching a Rule whose effect is REVIEW

steps.description: Steps is the ordered list of the review Steps. At least one Step must be set.

octelium.api.main.access.v1.Policy.Spec..title: Review
octelium.api.main.access.v1.Policy.Spec..description: Review is the multi-step review workflow that the Request has to go through in order to be approved

reviewers.description: Reviewers is the list of the Users that are allowed to review the Requests that reach the Step.

approvalRequirement.title: Approval Requirement
approvalRequirement.description: ApprovalRequirement is the condition that the Step's Reviews have to satisfy in order for the Step to be approved

approvalCount.description: ApprovalCount is the number of the distinct Reviewers that have to approve the Request. It is required for the COUNT approval requirement and it must not be set for the other ones.

timeout.description: Timeout is how long the Step can stay waiting for a decision. It is measured from the time at which the Step started (i.e. `status.review.currentStepStartedAt` of the Request). The Step does not time out at all if it is unset.

onTimeout.title: On Timeout
onTimeout.description: OnTimeout is what happens to the Request once the Step's timeout is reached

octelium.api.main.access.v1.Policy.Spec..title: Step
octelium.api.main.access.v1.Policy.Spec..description: Step is a single stage of the review workflow. The Request only moves to the next Step once the current Step's approval requirement is satisfied and it is approved once the last Step is satisfied.

user.description: User is a single User reviewer.

group.description: Group is a Group of User reviewers.

octelium.api.main.access.v1.Policy.Spec..title: Reviewer
octelium.api.main.access.v1.Policy.Spec..description: Reviewer is a User that is allowed to review the Requests that reach the Step

groupRef.description: GroupRef is the reference of the Group.

octelium.api.main.access.v1.Policy.Spec..title: Group
octelium.api.main.access.v1.Policy.Spec..description: Group sets every User belonging to a Group as a reviewer

userRef.description: UserRef is the reference of the User.

octelium.api.main.access.v1.Policy.Spec..title: User
octelium.api.main.access.v1.Policy.Spec..description: User sets a specific User as a reviewer

policies.description: Policies is the list of the standalone core Policies that are applied to the granted access.

inlinePolicies.description: InlinePolicies is the list of the inline core Policies that are applied to the granted access.

maxAccessDuration.description: MaxAccessDuration is the upper bound of the access duration that the requester can ask for in the Request's `spec.duration`. It defaults to 24 hours.

octelium.api.main.access.v1.Policy.Spec..title: Authorization
octelium.api.main.access.v1.Policy.Spec..description: Authorization is the access that is granted to the subject of an approved Request. The Cluster enforces it by creating a hidden PolicyTrigger that applies these Policies to the subject User for the requested Services and Namespaces until the access ends.

matchAny.description: MatchAny matches every Request. It must be set to `true`.

subject.description: Subject matches the subject of the Request.

resource.description: Resource matches the resource that the access is requested for.

all.description: All matches only when every one of its child Conditions matches.

any.description: Any matches when at least one of its child Conditions matches.

userRef.description: UserRef matches the requester (i.e. the User that created the Request) which is not necessarily the Request's subject.

octelium.api.main.access.v1.Policy.Spec..title: Condition
octelium.api.main.access.v1.Policy.Spec..description: Condition is the Rule's condition that has to match the access Request in order for the Rule to be applied to it

of.description: Of is the list of the Conditions that must all match

octelium.api.main.access.v1.Policy.Spec..title: All
octelium.api.main.access.v1.Policy.Spec..description: All acts as a logical AND operator on its list of Conditions

of.description: Of is the list of the Conditions of which at least one must match

octelium.api.main.access.v1.Policy.Spec..title: Any
octelium.api.main.access.v1.Policy.Spec..description: Any acts as a logical OR operator on its list of Conditions

octelium.api.main.access.v1.Policy.Spec..title: Resource
octelium.api.main.access.v1.Policy.Spec..description: Resource matches the resource that the access is requested for

groupRef.description: GroupRef matches the Users belonging to a specific Group

octelium.api.main.access.v1.Policy.Spec..title: Subject
octelium.api.main.access.v1.Policy.Spec..description: Subject matches the subject of the Request (i.e. the User that the access is requested for) which is not necessarily the same User that created the Request

status.description: Status is the current status of the Request.

octelium.api.main.access.v1.Request.title: Request
octelium.api.main.access.v1.Request.description: Request is a User's request for a just-in-time access to a Service or to a Catalog. Once it is created, the Cluster matches it against the access Policies and, depending on the effect of the matched Rule, the Request is either immediately rejected, immediately approved or put into a review workflow until the reviewers decide its fate. An approved Request grants its subject the access that is set by the matched Rule's Authorization until the access ends.

urgency.title: Urgency
urgency.description: Urgency is how urgent the requester considers the Request to be

resource.description: Resource is the resource that the access is requested for.

subject.description: Subject is the User that the access is requested for. It is automatically set to the calling User by the CreateRequest method and it must be explicitly set for the CreateRequestForSubject method.

justification.description: Justification is the requester's free-form explanation of why the access is needed. It cannot be longer than 1500 characters.

deadline.description: Deadline is the time after which a still pending Request is automatically expired.

duration.description: Duration is how long the access should last for once the Request is approved. It is capped by the `maxAccessDuration` of the matched Rule's Authorization which defaults to 24 hours.

serviceRef.description: ServiceRef is a request for the access to a single Service.

catalog.description: Catalog is a request for the access to a Catalog.

octelium.api.main.access.v1.Request.Spec.title: Resource
octelium.api.main.access.v1.Request.Spec.description: Resource is the resource that the access is requested for

catalogRef.description: CatalogRef is the reference of the Catalog.

octelium.api.main.access.v1.Request.Spec.title: Catalog
octelium.api.main.access.v1.Request.Spec.description: Catalog is a request for the access to every Service belonging to a Catalog

userRef.description: UserRef is the reference of the subject User.

octelium.api.main.access.v1.Request.Spec.title: Subject
octelium.api.main.access.v1.Request.Spec.description: Subject is the User that the access is requested for which is not necessarily the same User that created the Request

state.description: State is the current state of the Request.

userRef.description: UserRef is the reference of the User that created the Request which is not necessarily the same User set as the Request's subject.

approvalStartAt.description: ApprovalStartAt is the time at which the Request started waiting for a decision.

approvalEndAt.description: ApprovalEndAt is the time at which the Request reached a final state (i.e. APPROVED, REJECTED, REVOKED, EXPIRED or CANCELLED).

lastStates.description: LastStates is the list of the previous states of the Request, ordered from the most recent to the oldest.

policyTriggerRef.description: PolicyTriggerRef is the reference of the hidden PolicyTrigger that the Cluster creates in order to grant the access of an approved Request. It is removed once the Request is no longer approved.

policyRef.description: PolicyRef is the reference of the Policy whose Rule matched the Request.

rule.description: Rule is a copy of the Policy Rule that matched the Request at the time it was evaluated. It is kept here so that the subsequent changes to the Policy do not affect the Requests that are already in flight.

review.description: Review is the current progress of the Request in the review workflow.

accessEndsAt.description: AccessEndsAt is the time at which the granted access ends. The Request's state is set to EXPIRED once it passes.

octelium.api.main.access.v1.Request.Stat.title: Status
octelium.api.main.access.v1.Request.Stat.description: Status is the current status of the Request

currentStep.description: CurrentStep is the zero-based index of the review Step that the Request is currently waiting for.

lastSteps.description: LastSteps is the list of the Reviews that have already been applied to the Request.

currentStepStartedAt.description: CurrentStepStartedAt is the time at which the current review Step started. It is the point from which the Step's timeout is measured.

octelium.api.main.access.v1.Request.Stat.title: Review
octelium.api.main.access.v1.Request.Stat.description: Review is the current progress of the Request in the review workflow that is set by the matched Rule's Action

reviewRef.description: ReviewRef is the reference of the applied Review.

setAt.description: SetAt is the time at which the Review's decision was set.

stepIndex.description: StepIndex is the zero-based index of the review Step that the Review was applied to.

octelium.api.main.access.v1.Request.Stat.title: Step
octelium.api.main.access.v1.Request.Stat.description: Step is a Review that has already been applied to the Request

createdAt.description: CreatedAt is the time at which the state was set.

status.title: Status
status.description: Status is the state of the Request

octelium.api.main.access.v1.Request.Stat.title: State
octelium.api.main.access.v1.Request.Stat.description: State is a state of the Request at a certain point in time

match.description: Match contains a single CEL expression

all.description: All acts as a logical AND operator on its list of CEL expressions

any.description: Any acts as a logical OR operator on its list of CEL expressions

not.description: Not acts as a logical NOT operator of a single CEL expression

none.description: None acts as a logical NOR operator on its list of CEL expressions (i.e. none of the expressions matches)

opa.description: OPA contains an OPA (Open Policy Agent) Rego script

octelium.api.main.core.v1.Condition.title: Condition
octelium.api.main.core.v1.Condition.description: Condition is a policy-as-code expression that is evaluated against the request context. It is used by the Policy rules, the Service dynamic configuration rules, the HTTP Plugins as well as by the IdentityProvider rules.

of.description: Of is the list of the Conditions that must all match

octelium.api.main.core.v1.Condition.All.title: All
octelium.api.main.core.v1.Condition.All.description: All acts as a logical AND operator on its list of Conditions

of.description: Of is the list of the Conditions of which at least one must match

octelium.api.main.core.v1.Condition.Any.title: Any
octelium.api.main.core.v1.Condition.Any.description: Any acts as a logical OR operator on its list of Conditions

of.description: Of is the list of the Conditions of which none must match

octelium.api.main.core.v1.Condition.None.title: None
octelium.api.main.core.v1.Condition.None.description: None acts as a logical NOR operator on its list of Conditions

inline.description: Inline is the OPA Rego script directly provided as a string

octelium.api.main.core.v1.Condition.OPA.title: OPA
octelium.api.main.core.v1.Condition.OPA.description: OPA evaluates the Condition via an Open Policy Agent Rego script

name.description: Name is the name of the inline Policy

octelium.api.main.core.v1.InlinePolicy.title: Inline Policy
octelium.api.main.core.v1.InlinePolicy.description: InlinePolicy is a Policy that is defined inline within the resource that attaches it instead of being created as a standalone Policy resource.

rules.description: Rules is the list of Policy rules

enforcementRules.description: EnforcementRules is the list of enforcement rules that are typically used as a precondition for using the Policy rules. You can simply extract your shared conditions from your rules and write them instead inside enforcementRules for better performance and readability

attrs.description: Attrs is a map of user-defined attributes that can be reused inside the Policy rules. It is strongly recommended to stick to camelCase in order to be conformant with Octelium's API naming conventions.

isDisabled.description: IsDisabled disables (i.e. deactivates) the Policy. You can use this to temporarily disable enforcing the Policy altogether instead of having to delete it or de-attach it from the different Resources attaching it.

condition.description: Condition is the enforcement rule's Condition

effect.title: Effect
effect.description: Effect is the decision of the EnforcementRule once its Condition matches

octelium.api.main.core.v1.Policy.Spec.En.title: Enforcement Rule
octelium.api.main.core.v1.Policy.Spec.En.description: EnforcementRule is a pre-condition that decides whether the Policy is evaluated at all. If no EnforcementRule matches, or if the list of EnforcementRules is empty, then the Policy is enforced. ENFORCE rules always override IGNORE rules in the same way that DENY rules override ALLOW rules.

name.description: Name is an optional name for the rule. It is currently useful in Logs to understand which rule triggered the Policy.

condition.description: Condition is the rule's Condition that must match in order for the rule, and subsequently the Policy as whole, to match

effect.title: Effect
effect.description: Effect is the decision of the Rule once its Condition matches

priority.description: Priority is an integer that sets the rule priority level. The lower the number, the higher the priority. Currently the range of numbers is between -4 (i.e. the highest priority) and 4 (i.e. the lowest priority).

octelium.api.main.core.v1.Policy.Spec.Ru.title: Rule
octelium.api.main.core.v1.Policy.Spec.Ru.description: Rule is a single access control rule of the Policy

milliseconds.description: Milliseconds is the duration set in milliseconds

seconds.description: Seconds is the duration set in seconds

minutes.description: Minutes is the duration set in minutes

hours.description: Hours is the duration set in hours

days.description: Days is the duration set in days

weeks.description: Weeks is the duration set in weeks

months.description: Months is the duration set in months

octelium.api.main.meta.v1.Duration.title: Duration
octelium.api.main.meta.v1.Duration.description: Duration is a length of time that is expressed in a single unit of choice. Exactly one of the units is set (e.g. `seconds: 30`).

page.description: Page is the page number. Starts with zero.

itemsPerPage.description: ItemsPerPage is the number of items per page.

totalCount.description: TotalCount is the total count of items that can be obtained.

hasMore.description: HasMore shows whether a next page is available

octelium.api.main.meta.v1.ListResponseMe.title: List Response Meta
octelium.api.main.meta.v1.ListResponseMe.description: ListResponseMeta is the pagination information that is common to every List response.

uid.description: UID is the unique UUID value for the object assigned by the Cluster. Read-only.

name.description: Name is the name of the object. It must be unique within a certain API/Version/Kind tuple.

createdAt.description: CreatedAt is the timestamp of creation of the object. Read-only.

updatedAt.description: UpdatedAt is the timestamp of when the object was last updated. Read-only.

displayName.description: DisplayName is the name that can be shown publicly for the object. Doesn't need to be unique.

description.description: Description is used to describe the object in a short sentence. Maximum characters are 1000.

labels.description: Labels is a map of string keys and values to organize objects.

tags.description: Tags is an optional array of tags that classify the Resource.

annotations.description: Annotations is a map of string keys and values that can be used to store arbitrary metadata about the object.

picURL.description: PicURL is the Picture URL of the resource.

resourceVersion.description: ResourceVersion is a unique ID that represent the current version of the resource object. Used by the Cluster to detect updates.

lastResourceVersion.description: LastResourceVersion is the ResourceVersion of the last update of the Resource.

actorRef.description: ActorRef is the object reference to the Actor resource, typically a Session, who is responsible for the current resource change. If ActorRef is not set, then the current change of the resource was done by the Cluster

actorOperation.description: ActorOperation is the gRPC full method triggered by the actorRef to modify the Resource

isSystem.description: IsSystem means that the resource is created by the Cluster and it cannot be managed by the administrators. Read-only.

specLabels.description: SpecLabels is map used internally by the Cluster for quick searches among lists of objects. Read-only.

isUserHidden.description: IsUserHidden means that the resource object is hidden from ordinary Users and should not be exposed via the User APIs.

isSystemHidden.description: IsSystemHidden means that the resource object is hidden by the Cluster and should not be exposed via the APIs.

systemLabels.description: SystemLabels is a similar map to specLabels. Used only by the Cluster.

octelium.api.main.meta.v1.Metadata.title: Metadata
octelium.api.main.meta.v1.Metadata.description: Metadata is the metadata that is common to every Cluster resource. It carries the resource's identity (i.e. its UID and name), its human-readable information as well as the Cluster-managed bookkeeping of the resource's versioning and provenance.

apiVersion.description: APIVersion is the API version of the reference resource

kind.description: Kind is the resource kind. A kind is unique per an APIVersion.

uid.description: UID is the resource object UID. A UID is unique across the entire Cluster.

name.description: Name is the resource object name. A name is unique per a certain kind.

resourceVersion.description: ResourceVersion is the resourceVersion of the resource.

octelium.api.main.meta.v1.ObjectReferenc.title: Object Reference
octelium.api.main.meta.v1.ObjectReferenc.description: ObjectReference is a reference to another Cluster resource. It identifies the referenced resource by its kind and either its UID or its name.
